verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no registrable outbound HTTP webhooks. `GET /v1/agents/events` is a client-pulled progress stream, not a callback that Sai delivers to a consumer URL. The iMessage, SMS and Telegram notifications are chat-app alerts, which do not qualify as webhooks. The axis applies to an API-driven agent platform, but nothing in the pack delivers it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
